title: Occupancy Forecast Contract (DC-OCCUPANCY-FORECAST-v1)
description: Sprint 26 WS-A Foresight tier contract. One flat record per hospital x ward x horizon-hour (0..72h) describing the deterministic synthetic occupancy forecast that grounds the reference ontology hcp:Forecast ICE (forWard=Ward, explainedBy=Driver). Records are produced by the deterministic Foresight generator (data-platform/notebooks/foresight/build_gold_forecast.py) and materialise gold.fact_occupancy_forecast; the row shape is intentionally 1:1 with the Gold Delta table so the offline schema-conformance test can validate generator output. No PHI by construction (ward-level aggregate, no patient identifiers). ADR-0013 westus2 demo-scope + ADR-0016 gate 1 (_pseudonymisation_flag=true) apply. See docs/ontology/reference-layer.ttl and docs/ontology/crosswalk.md.

_pseudonymisation_flag.description: ADR-0016 gate 1: demo-scope dc-*.schema.json contracts declare all record identifiers are pseudonymised (no PHI). Occupancy forecast records are ward-level aggregates and contain no patient identifiers by construction.

forecastId.description: Unique occupancy-forecast identifier. Maps to hcp:Forecast.

wardId.description: Ward identifier (dim_ward_capacityunit). Maps to hcp:Ward via forWard.

producedBy.description: Deterministic model run id; the D2 seam where a real forecasting model swaps in.

bucketStart.description: Start-of-hour timestamp for this horizon bucket.

bedCapacity.description: Staffed bed capacity for the ward.

forecastOccupiedBeds.description: Forecast occupied beds at this horizon.

lowerCi.description: Lower bound of the occupancy confidence interval (beds).

upperCi.description: Upper bound of the occupancy confidence interval (beds); >= lowerCi.
